_comment: THE ONE AUTHORITATIVE RECORD of the three. Transcribed field by field from the DSpace full item record the owner captured in 9a60f6f, extracted with `pdftotext -layout` on 2026-09-20. Nothing here is inferred from the PDF, the filename or the library slug. FOUR FIELDS REPEAT and none is deduplicated: two dc.date.accessioned, two dc.date.available, two dc.identifier.uri, two dc.subject.mesh. THE LANGUAGE COLUMN IS TRANSCRIBED AS IT STANDS, including its absences: the record tags dc.title, dc.description and each dc.subject.mesh `en`, and leaves dc.contributor.author, dc.coverage.spatial, the dates, dc.identifier.* and dc.language untagged. An absent tag is NOT `en` -- it is a value whose language nobody asserted, and flattening the two would invent an assertion the source never made. ONE DISCREPANCY WORTH KEEPING: dc.description says '30 p.' while the ingested PDF has 33 pages (who-iris/library/wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng/structure.json, `pages: 33`). Recorded rather than reconciled -- the catalogue's job is to say what the source says, and a later tool comparing the two is exactly the kind of check this record exists to make possible.
